svg.title: Measured memory and simulation progress
svg.desc: A public chart generated from 2,873 minute-scale observations over 47.99 hours. It shows resident memory, private memory, and simulation tick.
svg.text: Observed run · memory and world progress
Recorded monitor window: 47.99 hours · 2,873 samples · no extrapolation to 48 h
At the final recorded sample the process was alive; the tick had not advanced for 9.0 minutes.
